digest.component_or_area: outbound parent reconciliation / Epic Link handling
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips was permanently red because it attempted to clear a sub-task's fields.parent, which Data Center 8.17.1 rejects with a 400 response; the cell must be re-homed to clear an Epic Link on a standard issue instead

clearing an Epic Link via {epic_link_field_id: None} is reachable through the managed-ref gate if the parent is primed by a local rebar edit (not created Jira-side), because should_propagate_removal fires only for refs in managed_refs

whether {epic_link_field_id: null} actually clears on DC 8.17.1 was untested until the harness proved it in green runs test_outbound_epic_parent_round_trips_via_the_epic_link and test_inbound_clear_parent_round_trips
the re-homed cell must not weaken its assertions — it must prime the parent through a LOCAL edit to ensure the ref is managed, and must include read-back verification after the clear

set_parent's non-sub-task branch lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch, making silent no-ops invisible; this gap is real but not currently masking failures, so it is deferred to keep the diff narrow
